item.title: Comment on What should I ask Chris Arnade? by Chris Arnade
item.description:
I'm the guy to be interviewed. I don't know if commenting on this is bad form, but I'll do it anyways because the bulk of my recent work has been about walking various cities of the world, and I thought this piece, on what makes a city walkable, would be of interest to commenters on this site, as a flavor of what I do now. Which is focus less on US social issues (I still comment on those), and more on global cities and

item.title: Comment on How did China’s internet become so cool amongst America’s youth? by M
item.description:
"The most fundamental reason China is seen as cool is that…China is cool, at least in some subset of products."

Isn't it just that Silicon Valley is now much more un-cool than in the 2010s, and that affects their social media products?

You've got the guy with the "masculine energy" comments and giant wife statue, the multiple times divorcee that lies about be a pro gamer and has the political opinions of your uncle at Thanksgiving, etc. Un-cool.
